paragraphs: Rabbi Avin bar Rav Nachman. Rav Yehudah told him, “Avin my brother, do not buy land adjoining a city,” Bava Metzia 107a. Bava Batra 94b: Ravin bar Rav Nachman recited a teaching. Yuchasin also lists him under resh, Ravin, where there is an error. Ravin b.N. objects; Rava said, etc., Yevamot 84b.
